scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with exact finite rational checks; classical Bernoulli/variance and bounded-dispersion ingredients credited. No independent audit, certification, or claims of exclusive novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar equal-leverage Bernoulli Galerkin sketch only; independent finite repetitions and fixed deterministic correction weight. Oracle variance-optimal weight requires the full coefficient mean. Uniform contrast statement is a sharp support-wise bound and does not give failure probabilities, higher-rank guarantees, or finite-precision behavior. The full 2026 motivating preprint was not available for complete originality comparison.
title: Sharp samplewise positivity frontier for scalar Bernoulli control-variate Gram sketches
